user_story: As a visitor to https://www.saucedemo.com, I want the login form to validate required fields so that I know what is missing. Acceptance criteria: clicking the login button [data-test="login-button"] with both fields empty shows the error container [data-test="error"] with text containing 'Username is required'; entering only username 'standard_user' and clicking login shows an error containing 'Password is required'.
